event.name: c. 2645 BC: Sekhemkhet’s unfinished pyramid at Saqqara; date approximate

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The Buried Pyramid article describes an unfinished step pyramid of Sekhemkhet at Saqqara, conventionally circa 2645 BCE. The broader dynasty chronology and reign placement vary substantially by scholar. This is a nominal contextual reference, not proof that construction began or was completed in 2645, that the building was completed at all, or that its estimated date is certain. Imhotep appears in a graffito on its enclosure wall; his exact architectural role is inferred, not established by this reference. Coordinates identify the site; radius is a game reference, not the building footprint. NewsIndex may also include the stored end year.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: Approximate conventional reference only, no established year of beginning or ending construction.
r2SourceEvidence.location_precision: Pyramid site coordinates; 20 km game radius is not the structure or worksite footprint.
